title: SIGNAL ZERO ordered replay sz-replay-1
$comment: The bounded raw decoder additionally rejects duplicate object keys, invalid UTF-8/BOM, numeric lexical variants, input above 16384 bytes and depth above 16. ReplaySpec checks puzzle identity, strictly increasing ticks and each tick <= bound puzzle.tick_limit. Tail SHIFT is trimmed only after verified success; schema validation alone proves neither completion nor score. Public replay commitments require a private 32-byte salt until finalization.
